description: React component for displaying and managing a list of log entries in the Mattermost admin console, including pagination, sorting, filtering, and modal display of full log details.

classes.name: LogList
classes.description: React component class for rendering a log list with sorting, filtering, pagination, and modal details.

methods.name: isSearching
methods.description: Determines if a search is active based on term and filters.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Advances to the next page of logs.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page of logs.

methods.name: getPaginationProps
methods.description: Calculates pagination start, end, and total counts.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Defines table columns with sorting controls.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates table rows based on current logs, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: showFullLogEvent
methods.description: Displays modal with full log details.

methods.name: onFilter
methods.description: Handles filter changes for log levels.

methods.name: showErrors
methods.description: Filters logs to show only errors.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI including data grid and modal.
